title: Designing Behavioral Profiles for Language Model Simulation of Out-of-Distribution Human Behavior
abstract: arXiv:2611.00661v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to simulate human behavior, but which descriptions of people improve prediction when experimental designs change remains unclear. We develop a framework that draws candidate behavioral features from the literature and constructs profiles from earlier human experiments. A profile-generation LLM assigns feature values from observed actions, messages, and surveys; a separate LLM simulates behavior using these profiles. By comparing simulated and observed outcomes in the learning data, we select profile contents through forward feature selection, adding features while they improve prediction. We then evaluate the selected contents without modification against outcomes from new participants under new designs. Across 616 public-goods games, 144 multi-party bargaining games, and 1,480 generalized 11-20 money-request designs, leading one-feature profiles predict human outcome distributions bet

translated_title: 设计行为画像用于语言模型对分布外人类行为的模拟
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于模拟人类行为，但当实验设计发生变化时，哪些关于人的描述能够改善预测仍不清楚。我们开发了一个框架，从文献中提取候选行为特征，并基于早期的人类实验构建行为画像。一个画像生成LLM根据观察到的行为、消息和调查为特征赋值；另一个独立的LLM则使用这些画像来模拟行为。通过在学习数据中比较模拟结果与真实观察结果，我们采用前向特征选择来筛选画像内容，在特征能够提升预测效果时逐步添加。随后，我们在不修改所选内容的前提下，将其应用于新参与者、新实验设计下的结果进行评估。在616局公共物品博弈、144局多方讨价还价博弈以及1480个广义化的11-20要钱实验设计中，表现最优的单特征画像能够预测人类的结果分布（原文摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文提出一个自动化构建LLM行为画像的框架——从文献提取候选特征、由画像生成模型根据实验数据赋值、并通过前向特征选择筛选画像内容，从而使语言模型在新的参与者与新的实验设计（分布外场景）下仍能准确模拟人类行为。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a framework that automatically constructs behavioral profiles for LLM simulation by extracting candidate features from the literature, assigning values via a profile-generation LLM, and selecting contents through forward feature selection, enabling accurate prediction of human behavior in out-of-distribution settings with new participants and experimental designs.
